title: IPC-7351B / IPC-7251 (PCB Matrix 2009 summary)

leadSpan.label: Lead span (tip to tip)
leadSpan.help: Outside of lead to outside of lead (E). NOT the body width (E1).

leadSpan1.label: Lead span L1
leadSpan1.help: Lead tip to lead tip, first direction (D).

leadSpan2.label: Lead span L2
leadSpan2.help: Lead tip to lead tip, second direction (E).

baseSize.label: Base body size
baseSize.help: Square base of the electrolytic capacitor.

height.label: Height (max)
height.help: Maximum seated height above the board (A).

BQFP.name: QFP with bumper corners, pin 1 side

BQFPC.name: QFP with bumper corners, pin 1 centre

BGA.name: Ball grid array
BGA.note: BGA names carry no M/N/L suffix (nominal only).

HDRV.name: Header, vertical
HDRV.note: Pitch = row pitch. Fill column pitch only when it differs.

MTG.name: Mounting hole
MTG.note: Give vias (V) or anti-pad (Z) when used; leave empty otherwise.

mfr.label: Manufacturer
mfr.help: e.g. MOLEX, JST, SAMTEC, TYCO, HIROSE, AMPHENOL

knownSourceIssues: Summary lists the polarized axial capacitor as "CAPPA" but its example is "CAPPAD"; CAPPAD is used here.
Summary lists the polarized radial capacitor as "CAPPR" but its example is "CAPPRD"; CAPPRD is used here.
Several through-hole examples end in "P" while the notes define fabrication levels A/B/C; both are accepted.
Height is taken as the maximum and spans/bodies as the nominal value - confirm against your library.
